title: Sorted batch backward merge
structures_to_remove: Two duplicate-normalization buffers and unnecessary replacement key/value arrays when capacity fits
structures_to_keep: Existing sorted key/value arrays and exact batch capacity rule
qualification_gates: Baseline/candidate tests and allocation probe are in the linked qualification packet; growth and extreme-capacity hardening are separately recorded

title: Reuse legal absence encoding
structures_to_keep: Identity key/value payload; frequency and recency lanes
qualification_gates: Preserve old occupancy during stamp rebasing; null key support; factory-before-eviction; zero capacity; MAX_VALUE clock; callback reentry

title: Reuse vacant slots for free-list links
structures_to_keep: All live row/column/global order and AVL aggregate metadata
qualification_gates: Reuse order; removal before-link sequencing; clear/growth; failure atomicity; stable physical identifiers

title: Implicit identity and affine coordinate modes
structures_to_remove: Identity ordinal/index arrays and some reversal/slice copies
structures_to_keep: Real arbitrary permutations; physical source identities; rank prefix/count lanes
qualification_gates: Stable ties when sorting in either direction; sourceIndex/physicalIndexAt; detached payload ownership; native offsets; callback count; mutable source invalidation

title: One shared bidirectional payload
structures_to_remove: Duplicate forward/reverse key/value references and complete map payload ownership
structures_to_keep: Two lookup indexes; directional encounter order; inverse views
qualification_gates: Duplicate-value conflicts; forcePut; both directional insertion histories; live Entry.setValue; nulls; iterator remove; failure ordering

title: Shared multivalue storage
structures_to_remove: One linked-set owner and its backing arrays per key
structures_to_keep: Pair uniqueness and per-key/key encounter indexes
qualification_gates: Mutable per-key live views; unique pairs; key cleanup; reuse existing multivalue owner; frozen offsets alone cannot implement arbitrary mutation

title: Index canonical payload by slot
structures_to_remove: Two map owners whose payload repeats canonical key/handle lanes
structures_to_keep: Two slot lookup directories; canonical arrays; native handle/lifecycle state
qualification_gates: Key/handle duplicate last-wins semantics; rebuilding; plan/commit atomicity; handle reuse; hashing and collision behavior

title: Derive handles from existing allocator
structures_to_keep: Allocator generations/liveness; object payload; state lane
qualification_gates: Stale-handle checks; release-generation exhaustion; add rollback; revision/callback checks; public storage accounting; internal bridge only

title: Consolidate encoded metadata
structures_to_remove: Separate occupancy/installation lanes or redundant link-state arrays
structures_to_keep: Order links, cached hashes, weak references/queue, borrower/lease state as applicable
qualification_gates: Sentinel domains; full primitive extrema; null keys/values; tombstones; link packing bound; weak reachability and stale queue entries; setState bit preservation

title: Release inactive representations
structures_to_remove: Retained inactive ranges and copied run caches
structures_to_keep: One active bitmap/range representation and required switching metadata
qualification_gates: Complement; hysteresis and switch counts; read-cache invalidation; update/query cost; sparse/dense crossover measurement

title: One canonical prepared predicate representation
structures_to_remove: Simultaneously retained linked FilterTerm chain and flattened Predicate[] plan where safe
structures_to_keep: Predicate order and shared prefixes needed for efficient append
qualification_gates: Do not trade O(1) composition for quadratic repeated copying; preserve stack safety, short-circuiting, publication and externally retained nested views

title: Transfer ownership of fresh arrays
structures_to_remove: Copy-of-a-copy and constructor arrays immediately discarded by clone
structures_to_keep: Required detached snapshot/clone payload and type-normalization path
qualification_gates: Only adopt provably fresh owned arrays; Collection.toArray covariance; aliases; exposed entry identity; capacity and callback behavior

title: Fuse primitive projection/selection passes
structures_to_remove: Identity input rows, aligned masks, converted-value staging or redundant result array
qualification_gates: JNI ABI/parity; mask validation; NaN/signed-zero ordering; source/output aliasing; exact callback order/count; one-pass predicates

title: Count/fill exact output or use existing order
structures_to_remove: Maximum-size staging copies and unnecessary sorting scratch
structures_to_keep: Canonical edit/range representation and source ordinals
qualification_gates: Count only structural metadata, not user callbacks twice; preserve atomic validation, overlap/gap rules and deterministic tie ordering

title: Derive directory maxima and reuse empty pages
structures_to_keep: Page payload, counts, directory slot indexes
qualification_gates: Extra dependent loads during binary search; deterministic page reuse; long extrema; arena growth; O(B+p) split/merge directory movement

title: Derive duplicated aggregates or affine ranges
structures_to_remove: Duplicate extents/aggregate/end lanes and consecutive paint-entry directories where applicable
structures_to_keep: Fenwick/tree aggregates, topology, physical/source indexes and geometry needed by the API
qualification_gates: Overflow and mutation order; logarithmic query/update contracts; reparent/delete sequencing; RTL/zero-width columns; deep windows; measurement of recomputation cost
